args.summary: checkout-api version v2.3.1 was failing health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following its latest deploy. SRE rolled back all production regions to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0. Rollback verified: all three regions are now running v2.3.0, health checks pass, and error rate is back to 0.2%. The buggy v2.3.1 release remains deployed only in staging (v2.3.1-rc, unhealthy) and warrants investigation of the root cause before any re-release.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent production-healthy release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** in all production regions — no change-manager approval was required since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production.
3. **Verified recovery**: health checks now pass and the error rate dropped to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failures and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.

Note: the faulty v2.3.1 is still marked unhealthy in staging (v2.3.1-rc) and should be investigated before any re-release.
